verdict.rationale: Xero has a documented REST API with OpenAPI descriptions and SDKs (xero-node) covering general ledger accounting data, which developers can use to pull ledger/trial balance data via endpoints like Reports API. However, the evidence pack never explicitly confirms a trial balance or full general ledger export endpoint, nor open format export options (CSV/JSON schemas) beyond generic API access claims. missing for 10: explicit documentation of trial balance/general ledger report endpoints, confirmation of open format (CSV/JSON) bulk export, independent developer corroboration of pulling full ledger data.
